description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transmission Reverse Guide Pin Screw
This Reverse Guide Pin Screw goes in the Transmission Shifter Housing and secures the Inner & Outer Springs and Shifter Ball inside the Housing.
This Low Speed Guide Pin Screw is located in the Top part of Transmission Shifter Housing Directly above the Low Speed Select Guide Pin.
Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Screw, Reverse Guide Pin
Qty 1 – Screw, Low Speed Guide Pin
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
